_doc: Per-model overrides for scripts/refresh/check_models.py. Keys match the 'model' field in data/v1/models.json. extra_urls are fetched IN ADDITION to the model's 'sources' and DO feed the change signature. news_query pulls Google News RSS for passive release/discontinuation signals — headlines land in news_headlines but NEVER feed the change signature (news churn would flag everything weekly). Pricing-aggregator URLs can be added per model under extra_urls at any time (public, no-key only). Entries are optional — models with no entry are checked using their models.json sources only. exclude_from_signature lists URL substrings that are fetched and recorded but excluded from change detection (verified-noisy rotating marketing pages). A defaults-level exclude_from_signature applies to every model (github.com: blob pages embed per-request nonces — two consecutive fetches of the same page returned different signatures in the 2026-10-12 Watchtower 2.2 calibration, so they can never be signature-stable). An exclusion entry ending in "$" anchors to the exact URL, so a vendor homepage can be excluded without excluding its pricing page.

Watchtower 2.6 (2026-10-12): bfl.ai/pricing is now a JS calculator shell whose static fetch carries no per-second video rate (2,249 chars), so BFL's official docs pricing page (docs.bfl.ai/quick_start/pricing) joins as a readable primary rate source — probed with the checker's own fetch path before being written down: 200, signature-identical across consecutive fetches, and its FLUX 3 Video table matches the record exactly (the page serves two renderings — the probe's 19,564-char variant and the 9,875-char variant the re-baseline run recorded, itself stable across three later fetches; the rate table is the same in both) (t2v/i2v $0.06 draft / $0.17 hd / $0.29 fhd / $0.40 qhd / $0.80 uhd; v2v $0.12 draft / $0.41 / $0.53 / $0.65 / $0.95). Signature-live, not excluded: a rate move there should flag. bfl.ai/pricing stays signature-live alongside it (the 2.2 anchor decision). Watchtower 2.7 (2026-10-12): bfl.ai/pricing served three different renderings within one pass — the 2,249-char calculator shell baselined in 2.6, a 22,122-char full rendering (five consecutive probe fetches, signature cb65d074…; its structured FLUX 3 Video offers match the record exactly), and a 4,680-char calculator rendering (13ffebdf…, the run's fetch plus six consecutive probes) that carries no per-second rate in its cleaned text. The renderings rotate in blocks, so the page can never hold a signature across runs — it joins this entry's exclude_from_signature as an exact-URL entry, still fetched and recorded every run. The readable rate watch is unaffected: docs.bfl.ai/quick_start/pricing stayed on its 9,875-char rendering (cb1e92d1…) across every probe and both runs this pass and remains signature-live.
